notes.title: What's new in version 1.6.0
notes.content: [p]Daifugō inspired competitions are now faster and fiercer! Ready? Set! GO![/p][p]• Time your sprint and be the first to shed cards in the new mini-game: Rhythm Rush![/p][p]• Compete in punchier matches in 2 halves, just like in real sports! [/p][p]• Climb the Coin Blitz leaderboards for a limited time. Play matches, earn Coins, and win Token rewards![/p][p]• Unlock Maya, a Krav Maga martial artist from Israel and her Spirit Pet, the Ram! [/p][p]• Improved scoring makes every card play and bomb drop feel more satisfying![/p]

notes.title: What's new in version 1.5.0
notes.content:
• Level up and customize your Athlete with new 3D Skins and Victory Dances to show off on your home court!
• Unlock higher Belt Classes for advanced gameplay! Ready for your Black Belt?
• Exchange updated Energy for Wild Cards creating new combos and big comebacks!
• Play with refreshed cards, timers, and Ability/Power UI! 
• Troll in style with a fresh batch of animated Emojis - drop them in real-time Big 2 battles!

notes.title: What's new in version 1.4.0
notes.content:
Dodge, duck, dip, dive, and dance your way to wins!
• Level up characters to unlock Victory Dances and show off your moves!
• Travel the globe and collect characters from around the world!
• Discover international stadiums with the latest City Tryout mode for quick games! 
• Tease your friends with the latest emojis in real time Big 2 play!
• Keep up your win rate and break opponent win streaks for big rewards!
• Enjoy the hottest card game inspired by the classic played by millions worldwide!

notes.title: Catch the biggest Dodgeball Dojo update!
notes.content:
• Unlock Athlete Abilities to combine cards into Bombs and overpower Big 2's!
• Transform Wild Cards to your desire and create wild swings!
• Play faster 3-player mode for more combo opportunities and fun! 
• Level up characters and tease friends in real time with free emojis!
• Collect more rewards by completing the latest Dojo Challenges! 
• Enjoy the hottest shedding card game, a beloved classic played by millions, and compete with friends and family!

notes.title: What's new in version 1.2.2
notes.content:
Kick off the New Year with updates in Dodgeball Dojo!
• Meet Osman, Türkiye’s youngest wrestling champion, and his Spirit Pet, the Stork. Check them out now in the Arcade!
• Don’t miss our New Year's Sale! Earn Tokens and unlock exclusive rewards to start the year in style!
• Don't forget Private Parties with friends and family to play personal matches with customized rules like Pusoy Dos, Capsa, 大老二, and 鋤大弟.
• General bug fixes and performance improvements for a smoother gameplay experience.

notes.title: GAME UPDATE ALERT
notes.content:
Ready for fun Big 2 tournaments in Dodgeball Dojo?
• Invite family and friends to a Private Party for personal matches with customizable rules!
• Enjoy three-player games with familiar rulesets like Pusoy Dos, Capsa, 大老二, and 鋤大弟.
• Unlock Stadiums around the world starting in Hong Kong and San Francisco, and win home court advantage!
• Improved pacing for Athletes and Spirit Pets with seamless game flows and faster animations!
